desc:
🐐 Climb. Lick. Grow. Don’t fall!

Be a goat with one goal: keep climbing! Lick salt from the wall to grow bigger, find your footing, and watch out for other players. Knock your rivals off the wall before they send YOU tumbling!

🧂 Lick salt to grow your goat
🧗 Climb higher and brave the drop
💥 Knock other players off the wall
⚠️ Watch your step—and your back!

How high can you climb before it all goes downhill?
